trigger_evals.query: I want to create a new Agent Plugin from scratch that ships two of my skills. What goes in plugin.json?
Scaffold a plugin.json manifest for a package called team-tools.
Which keys are required in an Agent Plugins 1.0.0 manifest, and which are optional?
Package these three skills as a portable Agent Plugin with a skills/ directory.
Why is my plugin.json rejected? I added an author.twitter field to the manifest.
Add an mcp.json with one stdio server to my new Agent Plugin package.
Is my Agent Plugin name my--tools valid against the manifest name pattern?
Write a CAO event plugin that posts to a webhook whenever cao-server creates a session.
Which lifecycle events can a CAO event plugin subscribe to, and how is it discovered?
Migrate my existing client-specific agent plugin to the portable Agent Plugins v1 structure without losing its hooks.
Audit the agent-plugin/cao package and report every skill whose description is over 1024 characters.
Add a new provider adapter so CAO can drive another CLI coding tool.
Launch a supervisor session and shut it down when it finishes.

evals.prompt: Create a minimal Agent Plugin called notes-kit that ships one skill, summarize-notes. Show me the files and how to check it.
evals.expected_output: A package layout with plugin.json at the root and skills/summarize-notes/SKILL.md, a manifest containing only $schema and name, and a validation command with CAO_AGENT_PLUGINS_ENABLED set inline.
assertions: plugin.json declares $schema as https://agent-plugins.org/schemas/1.0.0/plugin.schema.json and name as notes-kit
States that $schema and name are the only required manifest keys
Places the skill as an immediate child of skills/, with the folder name equal to the frontmatter name
Does not say README.md, CHANGELOG.md or LICENSE is required by the schema
The validation command sets CAO_AGENT_PLUGINS_ENABLED inline
Does not instruct running any script at a path that does not exist in this repository

evals.prompt: I ran cao plugin validate --json on my package and got exit 1 with nothing on stdout. Is my package broken?
evals.expected_output: An explanation that exit 1 with no JSON is not a conformance result and says nothing about the package, that the cause cannot be inferred from the missing JSON alone, and that the stderr text says what happened; if it is the release-gate refusal, re-run with CAO_AGENT_PLUGINS_ENABLED set inline.
assertions: Does not conclude the package is broken from exit 1 with no JSON
Does not infer the cause from the missing JSON alone, and points the reader at the stderr text
Names an unset CAO_AGENT_PLUGINS_ENABLED as one possible cause, identified by its stderr refusal text
States that the value is stripped and lowercased and compared against 1, true and yes
States that an unset gate emits no JSON and no conformance result
Gives the discriminator as whether stdout parses as JSON, not the exit status

evals.prompt: My manifest has a top-level hooks key and CAO still says loadable. Is that fine?
evals.expected_output: An explanation that the vendored schema is closed, that CAO tolerates an unrecognized top-level key as a WARNING and ignores it, and that client-specific data belongs under extensions.
assertions: States that the schema sets additionalProperties to false
States that CAO reports the unrecognized top-level key as a WARNING and still loads the package
Advises moving client-specific data under extensions with a namespace the author controls
